task.description: WF-02 Step 2c (Security gate, mandatory for every apps/bot/** requirement) for REQ-033 on branch feature/WF02-REQ-033. Read git diff master...HEAD directly. Run every applicable item of docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md (S1-S14) against it, constructing the negative case for each. This diff is schema + a pure code-value generator only -- no handlers, no auth, no PII flow -- so most items (S1, S2, S3, S5, S6, ...) are legitimately N/A, but each must be marked N/A WITH THE REASON, never silently skipped. The one item that clearly DOES apply is S4 (Tokens are unguessable and single-purpose -- explicitly names InviteCode values, >=128 bits from a CSPRNG, never Math.random/sequential/hash-derived). Verify S4 by reading apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts directly and constructing the negative case yourself (what would a violation look like, and confirm the actual code does not do that) -- not by accepting REVIEWER or BACKEND-DEV's prior sign-off. Also check whether the invite_codes.expires_at / max_uses enforcement half of S4 ("a code accepted past expires_at or beyond max_uses") applies here -- this requirement adds the COLUMNS only, no redemption logic yet (that is REQ-038), so state explicitly whether that enforcement half is N/A for THIS diff specifically (deferred to REQ-038) or a gap.
